title: Decode canonical v1 match intent without client authority overrides
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement decodeMatchIntent exactly as frozen in section B073 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Validate exact per-variant own data keys, nonempty bounded semantic option/power IDs (1–128 scalars), player IDs per common bound and safe nonnegative expectedRevision. Parsing containment-vote only validates shape and does not resolve D-CONTAINMENT. No actor, seed, role, deadline, Repair/Sabotage choice, nomination-pair or approval override may enter the intent.
acceptance: Every five canonical variant shape succeeds with exact detached values and no aliases for legacy actions.
Reject forged actor/role/seed/outcome fields, unsafe revisions, pair nominations and boolean approval.
Accessors/symbols/custom prototypes and inspection exceptions fail safely without invoking getters or leaking submitted values.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
